About

Creative planning, structured delivery

I am passionate about creating memorable event experiences and executing them with precision. My background spans venue management and operational logistics, and I work where creativity meets structured planning.

Beyond event delivery, I have a strong foundation in data analytics. I use data to understand audience behaviour, streamline facility commercialisation, and build solutions to real-world problems.

Today I work as a data specialist: reviewing large business datasets, upholding strict privacy and PII standards, and giving clear feedback that helps train AI systems. I am detail-oriented, comfortable in remote teams, and adaptable across industries.
